name: io.github.BlanketByte/wise-mcp
description: Wise balances, card payments, transfers and recipients, plus transfers you approve twice.

environmentVariables.name: WISE_API_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Wise personal API token (Wise → Settings → API tokens). Full access to prepare transfers, Read only for answers.

environmentVariables.name: WRITES_ENABLED
environmentVariables.description: Set to false for read-only. Writes are always two-step and transfers are paid by you in the Wise app.

environmentVariables.name: MAX_TRANSFER_AMOUNT
environmentVariables.description: Optional max amount per transfer, in the source currency.
